capabilities: Render tikz and tikz-native code blocks as SVG
Compile snippets and full LaTeX documents with LuaLaTeX, XeLaTeX, or pdfLaTeX
Discover PDF-to-SVG converters (mutool, pdftocairo, dvisvgm) with manual fallback paths
Adapt diagrams to dark mode with transparency without recompiling
Cache diagrams and invalidate them when input metadata changes
extras: Local compilation is off by default; the README warns it should only be enabled in trusted vaults because TeX runs with the user's permissions and can access files outside the vault. The plugin makes no network requests or telemetry. Bilingual English/Simplified Chinese interface. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot display TikZ diagrams on its own, so LaTeX users cannot preview their TikZ drawings inside notes.

requires.name: Local TeX distribution (LuaLaTeX/XeLaTeX/pdfLaTeX) and a PDF-to-SVG converter such as MuPDF, Poppler, or dvisvgm

summary: Renders TikZ code blocks as SVG diagrams by compiling them with a local LaTeX installation and an automatic PDF-to-SVG converter.
